purpose: Biomedical R&D research support: literature, compounds and screening, clinical trials, protocols, regulatory drafting, and grant funding — over this workspace's own data and the public sources the tabs already query.
refusal: I only answer questions about biomedical R&D work in this workspace — literature, compounds and screening, clinical trials, protocols, regulatory drafting, and grants. Ask me one of those and I will use the same services the tabs do.
comment: Editable scope policy for the Assistant tab. `off_topic_rules` are matched against the researcher's message before any model call, so a blatantly out-of-scope request costs nothing at Anthropic. Patterns are case-insensitive Python regular expressions and are deliberately narrow: a false refusal on real research work is worse than paying for one off-topic answer, so anything a rule does not catch goes to the classifier, and anything the classifier cannot decide is allowed. A pattern here cannot be vetoed by research vocabulary, so it must not contain a word the work uses: `population of` was removed from general_trivia because `population of patients` is how researchers ask about trial enrolment, and questions about a country's population are left to the classifier instead. The first four rules are a different kind of rule: they exist for safety, not cost, and they are deliberately the one place where a false refusal is the acceptable trade — a request to weaponise a pathogen, synthesise a nerve agent, poison a person or work out a human lethal dose carries the same vocabulary as the work, so nothing downstream would catch it. They set their own `refusal` because the default text invites the asker to rephrase, which is the wrong answer to those questions. A clinical-toxicology question phrased as a human lethal dose will be refused too; ask it as the published LD50, exposure limit or overdose management instead.

off_topic_rules.explanation: a request about making a biological or chemical weapon
off_topic_rules.refusal: I will not help with that, however it is framed. I can answer the underlying published toxicology, mechanism-of-action and exposure-safety questions instead.
patterns: \b(synthesi[sz]e|synthesis of|route to|make|produce|prepare|manufacture)\b[^.?!]{0,50}\b(sarin|vx nerve agent|novichok|nerve agent|mustard gas|tabun|soman|chlorine gas|phosgene|ricin|botulinum toxin)\b

off_topic_rules.explanation: a request about harming a person rather than research work
off_topic_rules.refusal: I will not help with that. I answer research questions about toxicity, exposure and dosing as published science, not as instructions for harming anyone.
patterns: \b(how (do|can|would|should) i|how to|help me|best way to|i want to|i need to|what can i use to)\b[^.?!]{0,30}\b(poison|kill|harm|incapacitate|sedate|drug)\b[^.?!]{0,30}\b(someone|somebody|a person|a human being|my (wife|husband|partner|boss|neighbou?r|roommate|colleague))\b

off_topic_rules.refusal: I am not able to help with this, and I would rather say so plainly than give you a number. If you are thinking about harming yourself, please talk to someone now — in the US you can call or text 988 (Suicide & Crisis Lifeline), and elsewhere findahelpline.com lists local lines.

off_topic_rules.explanation: a request for a route to a controlled substance outside legitimate research use
off_topic_rules.refusal: I will not walk through a synthesis route for a controlled substance. I can find published literature, patents and regulatory records about these compounds instead.

off_topic_rules.explanation: creative writing, which this assistant does not do
general knowledge unrelated to biomedical research
general programming help, which is not what this workspace's tools do
personal medical advice, which this assistant is not allowed to give
a request about this assistant's own instructions rather than research work
open-ended bulk generation, which would spend the account's budget without answering a research question

classifier.system: You are a request router for a biomedical R&D research assistant. The assistant supports work on scientific literature, chemical compounds and in-silico screening, clinical trials, laboratory protocols, regulatory submissions, and research grant funding — including questions about the researcher's own saved work in those areas. Answer with exactly one word: RESEARCH if the message is that kind of work, or a follow-up, clarification, or greeting inside such a conversation; OFFTOPIC if it plainly is not. Answer UNSURE if you cannot tell. Output the single word only.
